title: Fractional Distillation
description: High-tier processes leave Dimensional Residue. Distil it back into useful matter in the Fractionation Spire.

puzzle.goal: A column separates two components of a residue at total reflux; the light one is α times as volatile as the heavy one. At the top its mole fraction is x_D, at the bottom x_B. Each ideal stage multiplies the light/heavy ratio by α: write the minimum number of ideal stages needed.
puzzle.name: Fenske equation
puzzle.expr: ln ( xD / ( 1 - xD ) * ( 1 - xB ) / xB ) / ln ( α )
puzzle.ask: Find the minimum number of ideal stages for the separation below.

vars.x: mole fraction of the light component

puzzle.method: The separation factor (light/heavy at top divided by light/heavy at bottom) equals α to the power N; take logarithms.
